name: falcon
description: Falcon — early-stage real-estate investment platform for Gurgaon / NCR

scripts.scrape: node scripts/scrape/discover.mjs && node scripts/scrape/fetch-projects.mjs --force && node scripts/scrape/download-images.mjs && npm run normalize && node scripts/scrape/spot-check.mjs --n 10 && npm run report
scripts.scrape:resume: node scripts/scrape/discover.mjs --resume && node scripts/scrape/fetch-projects.mjs && node scripts/scrape/download-images.mjs && npm run normalize && npm run report
scripts.setup: npm run scrape && npm run build
